items.title: Ave Maria ... benedicta tu (Regis)
items.desc: Johannes Regis, Ave Maria ... benedicta tu. 3 voices (Discantus, Altus, Contra), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Reg2001); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0.
